title: Vikram and Betal: The Honest Servant

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about an honest servant.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a loyal and honest servant.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: The king could not find his precious necklace.
scenes.image_prompt: king searching for necklace worried cartoon

scenes.summary: The servant searches for the necklace.
scenes.text: The servant looked everywhere and found the necklace in the garden.
scenes.image_prompt: servant finding necklace in garden cartoon

scenes.text: The servant returned the necklace honestly without keeping it.
scenes.image_prompt: servant giving necklace to king cartoon

scenes.text: The king trusted the servant’s honesty. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: king praising servant while betal flies away cartoon

story: A king lost his necklace. An honest servant found and returned it without greed. The king trusted him because of his actions. Vikram said honesty is shown through actions.
